name: circuits-de-zap
description: Jeu web d'initiation aux circuits électriques pour les enfants de 8 ans.

scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @circuits/shared build && concurrently -k -n shared,api,web -c magenta,blue,green "pnpm --filter @circuits/shared dev" "pnpm --filter @circuits/api dev" "pnpm --filter @circuits/web dev"
scripts.build:report: pnpm --filter @circuits/shared build && pnpm --filter @circuits/web build && node scripts/build-report.mjs
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @circuits/shared build && pnpm -r typecheck && pnpm typecheck:e2e
scripts.verify: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm --filter @circuits/shared build && pnpm --filter @circuits/web build && playwright test
scripts.test:e2e:update: pnpm --filter @circuits/shared build && pnpm --filter @circuits/web build && playwright test --update-snapshots
